notes: Strike task, Phase II: residual striker. The action is a correction du on the straight-line pursuit controller at 6 m/s (which alone strikes 100 % without obstacles): |du| <= 0.1 * a_max on thrust, 0.25 * omega_max on the body rates. Sparse arena (3 obstacles, 1 free chaser at 2 m/s), scene visible; no filter in training. Reward as in strike.json (effort term on du). Trainer: critic warm-up 200k steps before the actor moves, and the action anchor 0.2 * mean((du / range)^2) in the actor loss (the Phase-I recipe). Variant with guidance features in the observation (line-of-sight direction, distance and log distance, relative velocity, closing speed, line-of-sight rate, errors in the yaw frame, target height) and the pursuit command it corrects.
